articles.summary: Cybercriminals don’t always need advanced tools to cause damage—sometimes, all it takes is a convincing text, email, call, or pop-up. In our latest Security Spotlight, we break down common social engineering scams, including package delivery scams, wrong-number texts, and fake tech support alerts. Learn the red flags to watch for and simple steps you can take to verify before you click, reply, pay, or grant access.
articles.title: Social Engineering: When Scams Start with a Simple Message
